name: vMix (StudioCoast)
notes: Partial catalog: general, input, playback, transition, output and overlay actions and the general, tally, playback and transition feedbacks. Audio, audio presets, browser, config, data source, layer, list, NDI, OMT, playlist, preset, PTZ, replay, scripting, title, util, video call, virtual set and zoom actions are not catalogued (src/actions/*.ts).
The 'input' option is a free text field (number, name or GUID, variables allowed), not a dropdown (src/utils.ts:137-144).
The mix dropdown (1..16 or Selected) is shared through options.mixSelect (src/utils.ts:146-171).
Built on @companion-module/base ~2.0.4: expressions are supported for option values; the module declares valid values per dropdown in expressionDescription.
Entries that spread a shared option (input, mixSelect, adjustment) carry the visibility condition of the spread site.
